app.name: evo-agents hub
app.description: The team's shared store for memories, skills, plans and knowledge graphs.

login.title: Sign in
login.heading: Sign in to evo-agents hub
login.description: Use your GitHub account. The hub reads only your GitHub login and never stores a GitHub token.
login.notConfigured: Web sign-in is not enabled on this hub. An administrator needs to set the client secret, the session secret and the hub's public URL.
login.unreachable: The hub API cannot be reached. Reload the page in a few minutes.
login.access: You only see the projects an administrator has granted to your account.
login.cli: On your machine, sign the CLI in with evo-agents hub login.

projectSwitcher.label: Projects
projectSwitcher.none: No project has been granted to you yet
projectSwitcher.loadError: The project list could not be loaded
projectSwitcher.hint: Open a project to see its content

userMenu.grants: {count, plural, =0 {No project grants yet} one {Granted on # project} other {Granted on # projects}}
userMenu.logoutFailed: Sign-out did not go through. Try again in a moment.

home.title: My projects
home.description: The projects the hub returns for your account, with your role and the highest label level you may see.
home.count: {count, plural, =0 {No projects} one {# project} other {# projects}}
home.emptyTitle: No project has been granted to you yet
home.emptyDescription: Ask a hub administrator to grant a role to {login}, then reload this page.

project.title: Project overview
project.noHarness: The project was registered without its harness paths.
project.adminWithoutGrant: You are a hub administrator without a role in this project: you can manage it but cannot read its content.

ladder.title: Label ladder
ladder.description: Levels from lowest to highest. You see content labelled up to your max level.

repos.title: Repos
repos.description: The repos declared in the project's harness.
repos.name: Repo

sinks.title: Sinks
sinks.description: Where the project's content may go, with the highest label level allowed there.

admin.title: Hub administration
admin.description: The number of rows in each hub table. Only hub administrators can see this page.

states.forbiddenTitle: You do not have access to this page
states.forbiddenDescription: The hub API refused the request for your account. If you need access, ask a hub administrator for a suitable role.
states.notFoundDescription: This page does not exist, or it belongs to a project you cannot see.
states.projectNotFoundDescription: The project is not registered on the hub, or you have not been granted access to it.
states.serverErrorTitle: The hub failed to handle the request
states.serverErrorDescription: Try again in a few minutes. If it keeps failing, send the request id below to an administrator.
states.networkErrorTitle: The hub API cannot be reached
states.networkErrorDescription: Check your connection and try again.
states.clientErrorTitle: The API did not accept the request
states.unexpectedDescription: Reload the page. If it keeps failing, send the reference below to an administrator.

kg.title: Knowledge graph
kg.description: The graph the hub builds from the project's pushes: build status, queue and node search. You only see nodes labelled within your maximum level.

tiles.hashDetail: The same inputs give the same hash

latest.title: Build #{id}
latest.noHash: None: the build has not succeeded

queue.title: Queue
queue.description: The project's build jobs waiting or running. A project runs one build at a time and keeps at most one waiting.
queue.empty: No job is waiting or running.

builds.title: Builds
builds.description: The hub rebuilds the graph after every push. This page is read-only: builds are queued by evo-agents hub kg push, and the web has no button for it.
builds.emptyDescription: The first build is queued when a member with the writer role pushes with evo-agents hub kg push.
builds.noGraphTitle: This project has no graph yet
builds.noGraphDescription: The graph appears after the first successful build. Push the project's data with evo-agents hub kg push.

search.title: Find a node
search.description: Search by name, id, path, code or words in the content. Results only include nodes labelled within your level.
search.hint: Up to 25 results, best match first.
search.visible: {count, plural, =0 {You cannot see any node of this graph yet.} one {You can see # node of this graph, by kind:} other {You can see # nodes of this graph, by kind:}}
search.nothingVisible: Every node of the graph is labelled above your level.
search.count: {count, plural, =0 {No results} one {# result} other {# results}} for “{query}”
search.emptyDescription: Try a shorter word, a node's full id, or clear the kind filter. Nodes labelled above your level never show here.

node.label: Label
node.weakStatus: resolved and proposed are weaker than parsed and declared: read the source before relying on it.
node.notFoundDescription: The node is not in the current graph, or its label is above your level.
node.olderBuild: The blob store did not answer, so this page reads build #{id}, older than the latest one.

evidence.title: Evidence
evidence.description: The items, revisions and spans the node was read from.
evidence.empty: This node has no evidence you can see.

relations.title: Relations by edge type
relations.description: {count, plural, =0 {This node has no relation you can see.} one {# direct relation you can see, grouped by edge type and direction.} other {# direct relations you can see, grouped by edge type and direction.}}
relations.caption: {count, plural, one {# direct relation of the node} other {# direct relations of the node}}
relations.capped: The hub reads at most {count} edges of a node; this node may have more relations.

neighbours.title: Neighbours of {name}
neighbours.caption: Edges of {name} in the graph shown: {count}
neighbours.ofFocus: {count, plural, =0 {No edges in the area shown} one {# edge in the area shown} other {# edges in the area shown}}
neighbours.ofSelected: {count, plural, one {Selected in the graph, # edge} other {Selected in the graph, # edges}}
neighbours.empty: No neighbour you can see in the area shown.

graph.title: Neighbourhood
graph.description: Nodes and edges within {hops, plural, one {# step} other {# steps}} of this node, at most {limit} nodes.
graph.help: The table beside it lists the same data. In the graph: arrow keys move between nodes, Home returns to the node shown, Enter opens a node, + and - zoom, 0 fits the graph.
graph.truncatedTitle: Cut: the graph draws {shown} nodes, the limit is {limit}
graph.truncatedDescription: {leftOut, plural, one {# more node within reach is not drawn.} other {# more nodes within reach are not drawn.}} This node has {neighbours} direct neighbours: see them all under <link>Relations by edge type</link>, or open a neighbour to see its own area.
graph.smallScreen: Narrow screen: the graph is replaced by the table of neighbours.
